module: Lua interface of the replay system (.rpl files under replays/). It drives the C++ file stream (be:getFileStream): manual or mission recording, playback, pause, speed, seek, rename, delete. It receives the engine state through stateChanged, republishes it to the UI (guihooks replayStateChanged) and to extensions (hooks onReplayStateChanged and onReplayCoreEvent), and enables or disables the playback action maps. Also handles automatic mission replays (replays/missionReplays/ and replays/userSavedMissionReplays/).
usage:
core_replay.startRecording()
-- later
core_replay.stopRecording({autoplayAfterStopping = true})
local list = core_replay.getRecordings()
core_replay.loadFile(list[1].filename, true)
notes: M.state contains: loadedFile, positionSeconds, totalSeconds, speed (rounded to the thousandth), paused, fpsPlay, fpsRec, state ('inactive', 'playback' or 'recording'), framePositionSeconds.

All file names are validated: relative to the game, under replays/, with the .rpl extension, without '..', without ':' or forbidden characters. Otherwise the functions return a failure result with code 'invalidFilename' or a message.

Many functions return a result {success, filename, message?, code?, ...} (replayOperationResult). Codes seen: ok, queued, invalidFilename, fileNotFound, streamUnavailable, streamPlayFailed, recordStartFailed, recordingActive, notRecording, playbackActive.
loadFile does not start playback right away: it queues the request and displays 'app:waiting'; playback starts in onUiWaitingState. A new call replaces the pending request.
The comment of setSpeed says '1=realtime, 0.5=slowmo, 2=fastmotion'. The change is instantaneous, without smoothing.
A manual recording is refused while a mission recording is active (UI message replay.cantManualRecording).

Probable BUG: getMissionReplayFiles calls career_saveSystem.getCurrentProfile() without testing that career_saveSystem exists (the career_career test comes after). Outside career, if career_saveSystem is not loaded, this raises an error.
The functions saveMissionReplay and removeMissionSavedReplay copy then delete the .rpl and .rplMeta.json files, and assume the meta exists (meta.missionId).

state.desc: Last state received from the engine (see notes). Initially only {speed = 1}.

requestedStartLevel.desc: Set to true by startLevel so that onClientEndMission does not stop playback during the intended level change.

onInit.desc: Extension initialization hook: asks the file stream to send back its state (stream:requestState).

stateChanged.desc: Called by C++ on every change of the replay stream state. On entering 'playback', disables the VehicleCommon/VehicleSpecific action maps and pushes ReplayPlaybackActionMap; on leaving, the reverse. Updates M.state, triggers guihooks 'replayStateChanged', hook 'onReplayStateChanged'(state) and 'onReplayCoreEvent'({event, state, ...}) with event among playbackStarted, playbackStopped, recordingStarted, recordingStopped, playbackPaused, playbackResumed, loadedFileChanged.

onClientEndMission.desc: Hook called at the end of a level: if playback is in progress and the level change was not requested by startLevel, playback is stopped with a message.

levelPath.desc: Path of the level being left (inferred from code).

onUiWaitingState.desc: Hook called when the UI waiting screen is displayed. It then starts playback of the file queued by loadFile (stream stop then play).

state.desc: True when waiting is active; otherwise ignored.

_getReplayVehicleData.desc: Called by C++: returns the vehicle data (core_vehicle_manager.getVehicleData) encoded as JSON.

setDebugEnabled.desc: Enables or disables the replay debug logs (tag core_replay.debug).

getDebugEnabled.desc: Indicates whether the replay debug logs are active.

logUiAction.desc: Writes to the debug log (if active) an action coming from the UI, with the prefix 'ui.'.

getRecordings.desc: Lists the .rpl files of the replays/ folder (without subfolders). Each entry: filename, path, key, basename, displayName, size, sortTime, map, levelName, metadataAvailable, missingMetadataFields. The level is guessed by scanning the start of the file (up to 1 MB); sort: current level first, then most recent.

getPlaybackContext.desc: Indicates whether a replay can be played and whether its level must be loaded first.

returns.desc: {success, filename, code, recordedLevel, currentLevel, levelKnown, requiresLevelLoad} or failure with code invalidFilename / fileNotFound.

getTotalSeconds.desc: Total duration of the loaded replay in seconds.

isGameplayAllowed.desc: Indicates whether gameplay is allowed during the replay. Currently always returns true (a TODO in the code plans an option).

getLoadedFile.desc: Name of the loaded replay file.

setSpeed.desc: Sets the playback speed (1 = realtime, 0.5 = slow motion, 2 = fast motion), without smoothing. Does nothing if the speed is already this value.

toggleSpeed.desc: Changes the speed. 'realtime' alternates between 1 and the last other speed (1/8 at start); 'slowmotion' sets 1/8; a positive or negative number goes up or down that many steps in the speed list. Informs simTimeAuthority.

pause.desc: Pauses or resumes playback. No effect outside 'playback'.

displayMsg.desc: Displays a notification (toastrMsg) 'Replay <level>' and writes a log.

togglePlay.desc: Toggles play/pause of the loaded replay. If the state is 'inactive', reloads and starts the file; outside playback and inactive, logs an error.

loadFile.desc: Queues the loading of a replay (displays the waiting screen; playback starts in onUiWaitingState). Validates the file name.

autoplay.desc: If true, playback starts immediately; otherwise it starts paused.

options.desc: options.pauseWhenReady = true: pauses again at the start when the world is ready.

stop.desc: Cancels a pending load and stops the stream (playback or recording).

stopAndUnload.desc: Stops playback and publishes an empty 'inactive' state. Refused during a recording (code recordingActive).

cancelRecording.desc: If a recording is in progress: stops it and deletes the file, then publishes the empty state.

startRecording.desc: Starts a manual recording in replays/ (name 'YYYY-MM-DD_HH-MM-SS <level>.rpl'). Refused if already recording, playing back, or if a mission recording is active.

stopRecording.desc: Stops the manual recording and updates the catalog (guihooks replayRecordingsUpdated).

options.desc: options.autoplayAfterStopping = true: loads the replay on stop.

toggleRecording.desc: Toggles recording: while recording, stops it; during playback, stops playback; otherwise starts a recording.

autoplayAfterStopping.desc: Play the replay after stopping. If nil: true for a manual recording, false for a mission replay.

returns.desc: File name if a recording has just started.

toggleMissionRecording.desc: Shortcut for toggleRecording(false, true): toggles mission replay recording.

returns.desc: File name if a recording has just started.

seek.desc: Jumps to a normalized position of the replay. No effect outside playback.

jumpFrames.desc: Moves forward or backward by a number of frames (stream:stepFrames) and displays a UI message.

jumpTime.desc: Moves forward or backward by a duration (stream:stepTime) and displays a UI message.

openReplayFolderInExplorer.desc: Opens the replays/ folder in the file explorer (creates it if missing).

startLevel.desc: Starts the given level in freeroam without spawning a vehicle (freeroam_freeroam.startFreeroamByName), marking requestedStartLevel so as not to stop playback.

removeRecording.desc: Deletes a replay and its .rplMeta.json file; stops it first if it is loaded; updates the catalog.

acceptRename.desc: Renames a replay (and its .rplMeta.json). A new name without '/' stays in the same folder; refused if the target exists. If the replay was loaded, it is reloaded under its new name.

getMissionReplayFiles.desc: Lists the mission replays (automatic and user-saved for the current career/freeroam) matching a mission, sorted by meta.time.

returnOnlyWithAttempt.desc: If true, keeps only those whose meta contains attempt.

getMissionReplaysPath.desc: Returns the folder of automatic mission replays.

saveMissionReplay.desc: Moves an automatic mission replay to the user-saved replays folder (career/<slot>/ or freeroam/) with its .rplMeta.json, then notifies the UI (recordingFilesUpdated).

removeMissionSavedReplay.desc: Reverse operation: moves a saved replay to replays/missionReplays/ (so that it is managed automatically again), then notifies the UI.

openMissionReplayFolder.desc: Opens the location of a replay file in the explorer; logs an error if it does not exist.
